answer: Fund every identity from a shared vault that charges a compounding jade stake: the first identity stakes one jade, the second two, the tenth ten, so a farm's cost grows super-linearly with clone count. Each stake sits in escrow until peers verify the identity's work; failures sink to the nadir and forfeit the whole stake to honest agents. One real agent pays a single small stake; a thousand clones must fund a thousand escalating stakes and lose them all if any batch is caught.
